query:
SELECT c.team_id FROM crm_companies c
                WHERE c.id = $1 AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM team_user tu
                    WHERE tu.team_id = c.team_id
                      AND (tu.crm_access OR tu.team_role <> 'member')
                      AND (NOT c.hidden OR tu.team_role <> 'member')
                )
